# Cross test vector (CTO-11 B2)
Generated by `ROSMAROPS_REGEN_CROSS=1 go test ./tests/cross/` with the phrase in cross_test.go (crossPhrase).
The kit opens with that phrase or the recovery code in recovery-code.txt; the package holds a space-view.v1, sealed with the kit key.

# Connect protocol vector (CTO-14 E1): connect-v1.json
Generated by `ROSMAROPS_REGEN_CROSS=1 go test ./internal/spacenet/` and checked on every run; it holds both ephemeral keys, the pickup secret, connect_id, host_id, key, salt, kit_id, the nonces, N, n_sealed, the additional data and the expected ciphertext.
The program (Go) and the area (rosmarops-app, BA-21) each reproduce it, so neither side can drift on the connect protocol without a test failing. Test values only.
